A LEAVES row runs only through run_catalog (CATALOG_COMMANDS, parameters built from the menu state by a Rule); none of the 79 runs from menu state without a dialog through that executor: web.* rows run on the web host (Surface::Run, key/offset/caret not in MenuState), board/variable/layout/adjustment rows need ids, text, positions or records. GUI-MENU-1's precedent: artboard.add etc. stay menu_path_pending although DOCUMENT > Artboards designs their homes.

Two candidates for the lead: (1) EFFECTS > Effect Stack > Disable All Effects -> effect.toggle {layer: selected, enabled: false} (no instance: the whole stack; STU-FX-011a: no separate smart filter concept) needs a run_catalog arm through Viewer::run_command and a Rule; the label-to-command mapping is a reading, not spec-given. (2) DOCUMENT > Boards > New Board -> board.add (all parameters optional) needs a gate: Profile::of never derives the board container, so container:board would grey it in every document, and no gate shows it available where board commands refuse not_whiteboard_document.

Reasons by what the command does (Unreached::NoMenuHome = reads, records, catalog and state queries): no_menu_home 16 = board.node.read, board.read, effect.parameters, effect.read, layout.character_attributes, variable.create_alias (the alias value record, a read), variable.resolve_for_consumer, web.code_hints, web.code_navigator, web.css_properties, web.document_types, web.media_records, web.regions, web.snippets, web.tag_vocabulary, web.template_regions.
